name: Maya
source: The first customer [url=https://vndb.org/c151995]Yatsume[/url] serves. A kind if not slightly strange girl, who acts in a similar way to how a much older woman would. She's close friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c152001]Haru[/url], who she adores.
